QuestInfo.name: Master Sergeant Fox's Secret
QuestInfo.0: #p2020003# in #m211000200# has a little secret. If you want to hear it, go to #m211000000#.
QuestInfo.1: Originally, #p2020003# was very sensitive to the cold. But now he is perfectly fine even in the coldest place in Ossyria, #m211000000#. This is possible because he carries a secret object with him. In return for telling you the secret, #p2020003# asked you to bring food for meals before he goes back to base.
QuestInfo.2: After giving #p2020003# the food, he showed me a cape that helped him withstand the coldest of cold. Apparently the person that gave him the cape is a man who's over #b300 years old#k...

0.0: Hey, why are you coiling up to the cold? That's not the spirit! If you were a member of the Alpha Platoon, then I would have gone after you hard for this!#E \n\n#L0# #bI'm sorry, but #m211000000# is too cold.#k#l
0.1: Ah, oh yeah... I forgot. The sheer coldness of #m211000000# brings a chill to everyone. But it's not good for you to be all crunched up over this!#E \n\n#L0##bYou must be really strong to cold weather?#l
0.2: As the Master Sergeant of the Alpha Platoon, this is nothing! All I need is a bit of energy, and this cold is nothing... and, there's actually something else you need...#E \n\n#L0##bWhat is it? Can you tell me?#k#l
0.3: You want me to tell you about it? Hmmm... This is a top secret... but yes I will, but only after doing me a favor. What do you think? Are you down for it?

yes.0: Alright then, get me #b#t4000088# x 50#k. I want to set aside some emergency meals before I head back. If you get me the goods, I'll tell you how to handle the cold of #m211000000#.

no.0: If you aren't interested, then oh well. There's nothing like blocking out cold with sheer concentration.

1.0: Hmmm... So you brought everything. This should be enough for me to return to headquarters. Thank you for your work! Now, should I tell you how I survived the cold of #m211000000#?

yes.0: The secret lies in the cape. Way back when I first got to #m211000000#, a #bfriendly old man#k gave me a cape that's laden with magic, and he told me since he's lived in #m211000000# for over 300 years, he didn't really need it. He's an incredible person, indeed. Is there a way we can get the cape again?

item.0: You're still missing some important parts. I need #b#t4000088# x 50#k quickly.
